resources.string: Messages are end-to-end encrypted. Unlike direct chats, the relay sees who belongs to a community and who sends to whom in it. Searches for public communities reach the relay. Joining always needs administrator approval. Text only for now.
This relay does not support communities yet. Direct chats remain available.
The action could not be completed. Check your connection and current membership, then try again. An invitation may have expired or already been used.
Community membership could not be verified
A membership list from the relay did not match what this phone had already verified, so it was not applied. Check the administrator\'s identity before retrying.
Searching starts after 2 characters or when you submit. What you type reaches the relay.
Private: found only with an invitation. The relay still sees membership and who sends to whom. Administrator approval is required.
After restoring your account, request the public community again or use a new private invitation to recover your owner identity pin. Message history is not restored.
Encrypted to each member · new members see no history
You are no longer a member of this community.
Delivery stopped; some members may have it
They stop receiving new messages. What they already received stays with them.
Delete this community and its queued messages?
It is deleted for every member. This cannot be undone.
You stop receiving its messages. Its history and key are deleted from this phone. Joining again needs a new approval.
The administrator no longer sees it, and the community is removed from this phone.
The community, its message history and its key are deleted from this phone. Nothing is sent.
The community is full; no one else can be approved.
An invitation works once within 24 hours. A private community\'s name travels in this code; joining still needs your approval.
